memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "I will bless those who bless you, and whoever curses you I will curse; and all peoples on earth will be blessed through you." - Gen 12:3 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Here is one of the most important promises in the entire Bible. God tells Abram that "all peoples on earth will be blessed through you." From this one man, from this one family, God's blessing would reach every nation on earth. The story that scattered at Babel now begins its long journey back toward gathering.

This is God's heart laid bare. He chose Abram not to bless one family at the expense of the world, but to bless the world through one family. God's love was never narrow. Even as He calls one man, His eye is on all peoples - every nation listed back in Genesis 10, every tribe and tongue.

And how was this promise fulfilled? Paul tells us plainly: "The Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, and announced the gospel in advance to Abraham: 'All nations will be blessed through you'" (Gal 3:8). This is a gospel promise, spoken two thousand years before Christ. Through Abram's line came Jesus, and through Jesus the blessing of salvation flows to every people on earth.

If you are a believer today, you are living proof this promise came true. The blessing reached you. And the same promise still calls us outward - God's heart is for all peoples, and those blessed through Abram's seed are sent to carry that blessing further.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you realise that God's promise to Abram reached all the way to you?
- How can you carry God's blessing to peoples who haven't received it?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, thank You that Your heart has always been for all peoples, and that through Abram's line the blessing of Christ reached even me. Make me part of carrying that blessing further.
Amen.
